description: Sum the numeric values in a list. Missing or null list uses an empty list; null and non-number values are ignored, an empty or number-free list returns 0, the output is always a Double numeric value, and non-finite inputs or results fail before output.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: Numbers to sum. Missing or null list uses an empty list; null and non-number values are ignored, numeric values must be finite, and lists over 65536 items fail before output.

outputs.name: sum
outputs.description: Returns the sum as a Double numeric value; an empty or number-free list returns 0, and non-finite results fail before output.
